description: Repeat failing tests (Playwright or pytest-playwright) with retries disabled and return a per-test, evidence-based verdict: CONSISTENTLY FAILING (real bug), FLAKY (pass/fail counts, error-signature variance, duration spread) or NOT REPRODUCING. Runs all repetitions in one process by default. `isolate: true` also re-runs the failures with one worker to tell parallelism bugs (shared state) from flakiness inside the test; `order: true` (Playwright 1.64+) runs the files in random orders to catch tests that depend on what ran before them. Defaults to the tests that failed in the most recent run.

config.description: playwright.config path or 1-based index when the project has several configs

headed.description: Run with a visible browser window

isolate.description: Also tell parallelism bugs from real flakiness: repeat in parallel (fully parallel, `workers` default 4), then repeat the failing tests with one worker

order.description: Also run the target files in `runs` random orders (Playwright 1.64+ --shuffle, one worker) to find tests that depend on what ran before them; returns the seed that reproduces it and the likely culprit test

projectRoot.description: Project directory; defaults to the server working directory

runs.description: How many times to run the tests (default 3)

separateProcesses.description: Start a fresh Playwright process per run instead of one --repeat-each process (slower; use when the flake depends on global setup or a cold start)

testFiles.description: Tests to diagnose ("file:line" supported). Defaults to the tests that failed in the most recent run.

timeoutMs.description: Hard wall-clock limit per run (default 120000); one --repeat-each process gets this × runs

name: diagnose-flaky

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Diagnose flaky test
